PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_4 Predictive Tool Recommendation
PHASE.GOAL: Implement T8 tools/recommend so agents can request no more than eight context-relevant tools before listing schemas.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: tools/recommend reads optional context text and optional run_id.
Recommendation engine detects work phase from run state first, then context keywords, then general fallback.
Response returns recommended_tools with name, relevance, reason, phase, and a suggested custom tools/list profile.

STEPS.step-2: Route tools/recommend through MCP tools/call and support a direct JSON-RPC method alias only if protocol tests allow it.
STEPS.step-3: Provide compact run-state signals needed for recommendation: status, current gate, module, and next action.
STEPS.step-4: Map run state and context to init, plan, implement, verify, debug, or general work phases.
STEPS.step-5: Test verify contracts, debug M-AUTH, no context, and run_id-aware recommendations.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: tools/recommend context='verify contracts' includes verify_project, review_code, and traceability_report.
tools/recommend context='debug M-AUTH' includes diagnose_failure, self_heal, and analyze_logs.
tools/recommend without context returns general essentials.
tools/recommend with run_id returns phase-dependent recommendations.
tools/recommend plus custom terse tools/list stays at or below 300 estimated schema tokens.

RISKS.RISK: Keyword-only recommendation can be noisy; prioritize persisted run state when run_id is present.
A direct method named tools/recommend may conflict with MCP method namespace; keep tool-call path authoritative.
